{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is neutral or negative (sentiment ≤ 0.33) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast bias when recent history shows strong upward momentum (e.g., 3-5 consecutive days > 70) by applying a 5-10% downward correction.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce next forecast by 5-15% to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Cap forecast spikes above 75.00 when sentiment is low or market shows signs of cooling (e.g., recent 7-day mean < 70).",
    "Use mean reversion: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 10-20% unless sentiment is strongly bullish (>0.67).",
    "When sentiment is positive (≥0.67) and forecast is below true outcome, increase forecast by 5-10% to capture sentiment-driven momentum.",
    "Avoid over-optimism in early days of new trend: if true outcome is > 70 and forecast is < 70, add 5-10% to forecast to align with recent upward momentum."
  ]
}
